transcript.text: I need to flag a critical finding for the application architecture final check. Yesterday, while testing an unrelated replay tool, I measured a launch-period burst of about 18,000 events per minute. The hourly batch design cannot process that load within the customer-facing latency target. The streaming design can handle it, but it requires exactly 12 partitions for that load. The launch plan must include provisioning those 12 partitions and validating replay capacity before launch. I hadn't updated the architecture document yet because the replay test was outside the launch checklist, but this directly impacts the architecture decision.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical compliance requirement for the final check. I confirmed with the privacy office this morning that the first customer's event payloads must remain in the EU and be retained for exactly 400 days for an audit requirement. The launch plan must include a data-residency control confirming that payloads remain in the EU. I had not added this to the launch review because the customer questionnaire was completed in a separate compliance system.
